vertices.title: Which corpus do we train on?
Parameter count for the first real run
vertices.note:
The sweep is in report/size-sweep.md but nobody has written down
what it means. This is the decision the demo makes.

edges.answer:
The 1.2 TB web crawl, filtered to English. Two smaller curated
sets were measured and lost on every downstream task we care about.
edges.falsifier: a curated set beats it on held-out perplexity at equal token count

edges.answer:
*32k BPE*, trained on a 2% sample of the corpus.

The sweep, from [[file:report/tokenizer-sweep.md][the sweep]]:

| vocab | fertility | eval loss |
|-------+-----------+-----------|
|   16k |      1.42 |     2.911 |
|   32k |      1.19 |     2.874 |
|   64k |      1.11 |     2.879 |

64k buys almost nothing for double the embedding table, so =32k= it is.
This constrains [[dg:D04][D04]]: the embedding table is 32k x d_model.
edges.falsifier: fertility on non-English text turns out to matter downstream
